Example PhD Research Studentship

Fully funded PhD studentships are open to applicants of all nationalities.

The studentship includes a tuition fee waiver and an annual stipend of GBP 19,000 per year.

Applicants must contact a potential supervisor before applying and submit a research proposal of up to 2000 words.

The application deadline is usually in early February.

Eligibility requirements and how to apply are listed below.
